limitations: same provider supplies retained historical features and target
no transaction counts, quantities, sale timestamps, or true liquidity evidence
short-window persistence likely explains much of the retrospective gain
eBay active-listing asks are excluded as price authority

P0.name: PRIOR_OBSERVATION
P0.definition: Most recent canonical TCGplayer Market Price whose availability timestamp is strictly before origin time.

P1.name: 7_DAY_ROBUST_LEVEL
P1.definition: Median of observed canonical Market Prices in [origin-7 calendar days, origin), with no synthetic daily fill.

P2.name: 30_DAY_ROBUST_LEVEL
P2.definition: Median of observed canonical Market Prices in [origin-30 calendar days, origin), with no synthetic daily fill.

P3.name: LOCAL_LOG_LINEAR_TREND
P3.definition: Fit unweighted ordinary least squares of log(price) on elapsed calendar days over observed points in [origin-30 calendar days, origin); anchor at the fitted line and extrapolate exactly h calendar days for h in {1,7,30}.
P3.fallback: unavailable; do not substitute another baseline

selection_of_model_1.procedure: Select one of P0-P3 using only preregistered rolling-origin validation dates strictly before the final training cutoff.
ranking: highest count of price bands with positive dollar R2
simpler baseline in order P0, P1, P2, P3

A_LEVEL_PERSISTENCE: fixed half-life 7-day exponentially weighted price level
B_DYNAMIC_HISTORY: relative return versus set, era, and Treatment peers with target card excluded
D_MARKET_ANCHOR: frozen defensible F2R target-blind peer/market-anchor features
feature_families.separation_rule: Every feature must be registered under exactly one family before the cutoff; unregistered or silently cross-family features are forbidden.
feature_families.dynamic_exclusion: Family B excludes raw absolute lagged price, rolling absolute price levels, and transformations from which absolute lagged price is directly recoverable.

future_models.common_estimator: Fixed Ridge(alpha=1.0) on log target with fold-local median imputation, missing indicators, and standardization; no hyperparameter search.

references.STRUCTURAL_BASELINE: Frozen F2 structural baseline reproduced without refitting against holdout.
references.F2R_BASELINE: Frozen failed F2R target-blind market-anchor baseline reproduced without refitting against holdout.

future_models.MODEL_1: One pre-holdout-selected simple baseline from P0-P3
future_models.MODEL_2: B dynamic history only; no absolute lagged price level
future_models.MODEL_4: C structural + D market anchor + B dynamic
future_models.MODEL_5: C structural + D market anchor + A level/persistence + B dynamic
prohibitions: no final model fit or tuning before readiness
no feature or threshold changes after holdout reveal

temporal_leakage_contract.availability: For an origin T, each input must have an immutable captured/available timestamp strictly less than T. A date-d daily snapshot becomes eligible no earlier than completion of ingestion and therefore cannot predict date d.
temporal_leakage_contract.embargo: At least one calendar day: an origin on date d can use at most a successfully retained snapshot from d-1.
forbidden: revisions learned or written after origin T
retrospective use of a backfilled row without evidence that it was originally available before T
temporal_leakage_contract.missing_dates: Use observed points only. Do not synthesize daily prices. P0 may carry the latest prior observation for at most 3 calendar days and must expose staleness; otherwise the feature is unavailable.
temporal_leakage_contract.missing_feature_handling: Training-fold median imputation with an explicit missingness indicator is permitted for learned models; future or global imputation is forbidden.
temporal_leakage_contract.peer_features: Computed as of T with the target card excluded from peer aggregates.
temporal_leakage_contract.provenance: Persist source row identifiers, captured timestamps, feature-window bounds, code/feature-registry hash, cutoff, cohort hash, and prediction hash.

future_holdout.minimum_readiness: At least 90% of the frozen eligible cohort has 180 directly retained daily observations; every scored card must individually have 180.
future_holdout.preferred_maturity: Twelve complete selected-card monthly regimes where feasible.
future_holdout.cutoff: Choose calendar date C only after readiness, before inspecting any outcome after C; train and select using data available through C only.
future_holdout.development_validation: Expanding-window rolling origins strictly before C, with all preprocessing inside each origin and reports grouped by canonical root set.
future_holdout.final_period: Thirty contiguous daily origins C+1 through C+30. Freeze one model per registered comparison at C, generate predictions at each origin using only then-available features, hash predictions before any corresponding outcomes are read, and wait through C+60 so 30-day targets mature.

panels.recurring: Primary panel: frozen eligible cards/root sets previously observed by C.
panels.unseen_roots: Secondary panel: genuinely new canonical root sets after C, reported separately when at least 3 roots and 30 cards are available; never pooled to rescue the primary result.

future_holdout.optimization: No model, feature, cohort, baseline, threshold, or conclusion-gate optimization against the final period.
future_holdout.availability_reporting: Report prediction coverage and missingness; metrics use paired rows available to both models in a comparison, and unavailability may not be silently dropped.

horizon_contract: For origin T and horizon h, score only the exact provider observation date T+h. If absent, that card-origin-horizon is unavailable; do not substitute the next observation. Horizons diagnose persistence and do not redefine Fair Value as forecasting.

price_band_contract.basis: Exact future target TCGplayer Market Price, assigned only after predictions are frozen.
price_band_contract.high_value_visibility: List every target >=100 USD individually with card/root identity, origin, horizon, actual, each prediction, absolute error, and percentage error.
price_band_contract.small_n: Always show n; mark inference descriptive when n<30 and never pool bands to hide failure.

materiality.uncertainty: Paired 2000-replicate block bootstrap by canonical root set and origin date, deterministic seed 20260913; report 95% intervals.
materiality.coverage_gate: At least 90% paired prediction coverage globally and 80% in each price band at the decision horizon.

incremental_signal_gates.MODEL_2_vs_STRUCTURAL_BASELINE_at_30_day: At least +0.05 dollar R2, 10% lower MAE, and 10% lower MdAPE.
incremental_signal_gates.MODEL_4_vs_F2R_BASELINE_at_30_days: At least +0.05 dollar R2, 10% lower MAE, and 10% lower MdAPE.

consistency_gates: At least two-thirds of eligible root sets have lower 30-day MdAPE for MODEL_5 than MODEL_1.
At least 5 of 7 price bands have positive MODEL_5 dollar R2.
Both 100-250 and 250-plus bands have positive MODEL_5 dollar R2 and at least 10% lower MAE than MODEL_1; if either has n<30, this gate remains unresolved rather than passed.
One-day results are descriptive and cannot satisfy the decision by themselves.
materiality.rationale: Thresholds require gains larger than ordinary rounding/provider noise, materially repair the known F2/F2R dollar-tail weakness, and prevent excellent one-day same-provider persistence from being called independent Fair Value evidence.

conclusion_gates.HISTORY_TRACKER_ONLY: Collection and coverage pass, but MODEL_5 does not pass the 30-day persistence gate or the dynamic-only incremental gates; history may track or denoise provider price but independent Fair Value is unproven.
conclusion_gates.FAIR_VALUE_HISTORY_SUPPORTED: Temporal integrity and coverage pass; every 30-day and supporting 7-day materiality gate passes; MODEL_2 and MODEL_4 pass their incremental gates; root, band, and high-value consistency gates pass. This supports continued Fair Value research, not automatic production publication.
conclusion_gates.FAIR_VALUE_NEEDS_TRANSACTION_DATA: Use when temporal/data maturity is inadequate, prospective history fails materially, or either high-value band remains negative, underpowered, or unstable, indicating sale-level liquidity and/or independent multi-source evidence is required.
conclusion_gates.precedence: Integrity violation or unresolved high-value gate prevents FAIR_VALUE_HISTORY_SUPPORTED. If collection is healthy and persistence alone wins, use HISTORY_TRACKER_ONLY; otherwise use FAIR_VALUE_NEEDS_TRANSACTION_DATA.

collection_health.pathway: Existing canonical daily TCGplayer ingestion writes append-only/latest-wins daily rows to public.card_variant_price_observations; Price Storage V2 and monthly rollups are downstream derived stores.
collection_health.reason: The canonical pipeline already retains daily observations and downstream rollups. Existing observation tables can answer readiness; a second collector or historical mutation would add risk without new authority.
future_readiness_report: cards and percentages at >=90, >=120, and >=180 observed days
ingestion/run failures and late/backfilled rows kept separate

readiness_milestones.assumption: One usable observation per card per calendar day after 2026-09-12, with no further gaps; dates use current all-canonical p10 depth 71 so they approximate 90%-cohort readiness.

twelve_monthly_regimes.basis: Twelve complete selected-card calendar months from July 2026 through June 2027, evaluated after June closes.

security_advisory_separate.note: The public table requires a separate access/policy audit. Do not blindly enable RLS because existing readers/writers may depend on current access.
